fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
Interpreter on Thursday, and the reason stays with HR

Applicants ask before the interview. A deaf candidate for a warehouse associate job uses the request link on the careers page to ask for an ASL interpreter. The recruiter gets a task to book one for Thursday at 2:00 PM. The interviewer's calendar invite says an interpreter will attend, with nothing about why.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { employeeRequests: "Build an accommodation request form for my company. Ask employees which part of their job has become hard and what change would help, in their own words, with no diagnosis field. Send every request to our coordinator, Dana Brooks, with the time it arrived, and do not copy the employee's manager. Show Dana a list of open requests with the newest at the top.", interactiveProcess: "Give each accommodation request a case page where my HR coordinator logs every meeting with the employee. For each meeting, record the options we discussed and why each was kept or ruled out. When she approves one, generate a written decision letter with the accommodation and its start date, and send it to the employee by email.", medicalDocumentation: "When my coordinator decides she needs documentation, let her send a short form to the employee's health care provider asking about the limits that affect the requested change. Save the reply in a separate medical records table that managers cannot open. The manager should see only the approved change, such as a new start time, with no reason attached.", jobApplicants: "Add an accommodation request link to our careers page for job applicants. Ask for the position, the interview time and the change they need, such as an ASL interpreter. Create a task for the recruiter to arrange it before the interview, and update the interviewer's calendar invite to say what will be different without saying why." };

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: A candidate for a warehouse associate job asks on the careers page for an ASL interpreter at a Thursday 2:00 PM interview; the recruiter gets a task to book one, and the interviewer's invite will say an interpreter will attend.
